mapper.select: SELECT stock_Date, glue, ifnull(stock_num, 0) AS stock_num, ifnull(stock_weight, 0) AS stock_weight, valid_time AS valid_time FROM T_GLUE_STOCK p WHERE p.STOCK_DATE = #{stockDate} AND p.del_flag = '0' AND p.mix_area = #{mixArea} ORDER BY valid_time

SELECT stock_Date, glue, ifnull(stock_num, 0) AS stock_num, ifnull(stock_weight, 0) AS stock_weight, valid_time AS valid_time FROM T_ML_GLUE_STOCK p WHERE p.STOCK_DATE = #{stockDate} AND p.del_flag = '0' AND p.mix_area = #{mixArea} ORDER BY valid_time

SELECT stock_Date, glue, ifnull(stock_num, 0) AS stock_num, ifnull(stock_weight, 0) AS stock_weight, valid_time AS valid_time FROM T_BHG_GLUE_STOCK p WHERE p.STOCK_DATE = #{stockDate} AND p.del_flag = '0' AND p.mix_area = #{mixArea} ORDER BY valid_time

SELECT stock_Date, glue, ifnull(stock_num, 0) AS stock_num, ifnull(stock_weight, 0) AS stock_weight, valid_time AS valid_time FROM T_FH_GLUE_STOCK p WHERE p.STOCK_DATE = #{stockDate} AND p.del_flag = '0' AND p.mix_area = #{mixArea} ORDER BY valid_time
SELECT glue, ifnull(safe_stock, 0) AS Stock_Num FROM T_GLUE_SAFE_STOCK p WHERE p.del_flag = '0' AND p.mix_area = #{mixArea}
SELECT f.order_no, SUM(f.finish_qty) finish_qty FROM T_GLUE_PART_FINISH f WHERE f.schedule_date = #{scheduleDate} AND f.mix_area = #{mixArea} AND f.del_flag = '0' GROUP BY f.order_no, f.schedule_date

SELECT MIX_AREA, SCHEDULE_DATE, GLUE, ifnull(SUM(SHELF_NUM1), 0) SHELF_NUM1, ifnull(SUM(SHELF_NUM2), 0) SHELF_NUM2 FROM T_GLUE_UNCLAIMED WHERE SCHEDULE_DATE = #{scheduleDate} AND MIX_AREA = #{mixArea} AND DEL_FLAG = '0' GROUP BY MIX_AREA, SCHEDULE_DATE, GLUE

SELECT concat(GLUE , '-F'), STOCK_WEIGHT, TRUNCATE(STOCK_WEIGHT / 2, 1) NIGHT_STOCK, STOCK_WEIGHT - TRUNCATE(STOCK_WEIGHT / 2, 1) DAY_STOCK FROM (SELECT P.GLUE, TRUNCATE(P.TOTAL_PLAN_QTY * RE.LOT_TOTAL_WEIGHT * R.RETURN_RATE / 100, 1) STOCK_WEIGHT FROM T_GLUE_COLLECT_PLAN P INNER JOIN T_FH_GLUE_RETURN_RATE R ON R.MIX_AREA = P.MIX_AREA AND R.GLUE = P.GLUE LEFT JOIN (SELECT R1.RECIPE_MATERIAL_NAME, R1.MIX_AREA, MIN(R1.LOT_TOTAL_WEIGHT) LOT_TOTAL_WEIGHT FROM T_MES_PMT_RECIPE R1 INNER JOIN T_MES_BAS_MATERIAL M ON M.MATERIAL_CODE = R1.RECIPE_MATERIAL_CODE AND M.MAJOR_TYPE = '5' AND M.DEL_FLAG = '0' INNER JOIN T_RECIPE_TYPE RT ON RT.RECIPE_TYPE_CODE = R1.RECIPE_TYPE AND RT.DEL_FLAG = '0' WHERE R1.AUDIT_FLAG = '1' AND R1.RECIPE_STATE = '1' AND R1.MIX_AREA = #{mixArea} AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM T_MES_PMT_RECIPE R2 INNER JOIN T_MES_BAS_MATERIAL M2 ON M2.MATERIAL_CODE = R2.RECIPE_MATERIAL_CODE AND M2.MAJOR_TYPE = '5' AND M2.DEL_FLAG = '0' INNER JOIN T_RECIPE_TYPE RT2 ON RT2.RECIPE_TYPE_CODE = R2.RECIPE_TYPE AND RT2.DEL_FLAG = '0' WHERE R2.RECIPE_MATERIAL_NAME = R1.RECIPE_MATERIAL_NAME AND R2.RECIPE_EQUIP_CODE = R1.RECIPE_EQUIP_CODE AND R2.MIX_AREA = R1.MIX_AREA AND R2.AUDIT_FLAG = '1' AND R2.RECIPE_STATE = '1' AND CASE WHEN RT2.RECIPE_TYPE_NAME LIKE 'C2Z%' THEN 1 WHEN RT2.RECIPE_TYPE_NAME LIKE 'ZZ%' THEN 3 WHEN RT2.RECIPE_TYPE_NAME LIKE 'CS%' THEN 4 WHEN RT2.RECIPE_TYPE_NAME LIKE 'S%' THEN 5 ELSE 2 END < CASE WHEN RT.RECIPE_TYPE_NAME LIKE 'C2Z%' THEN 1 WHEN RT.RECIPE_TYPE_NAME LIKE 'ZZ%' THEN 3 WHEN RT.RECIPE_TYPE_NAME LIKE 'CS%' THEN 4 WHEN RT.RECIPE_TYPE_NAME LIKE 'S%' THEN 5 ELSE 2 END
) GROUP BY R1.RECIPE_MATERIAL_NAME, R1.MIX_AREA) RE ON RE.RECIPE_MATERIAL_NAME = R.GLUE WHERE P.DEL_FLAG = '0' AND P.MIX_AREA = #{mixArea} AND P.PLAN_DATE = #{scheduleDate}) as GSW
